title: Venezuelan Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious lentil pilaf dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine. This recipe combines the earthy taste of lentils with the aromatic spices of Venezuela.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and pick out any debris.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the lentils, pilaf, and zesty seasoning to the saucepan. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Optional: Add sliced avocado or a dollop of sour cream for extra flavor.
